svg.title: Refurbished Marketplace architecture
svg.desc: Runtime architecture, catalog-to-search and checkout-to-payment flows, Kafka events, GitOps, and observability.

text.tspan: Runtime architecture / Talos dev + prod / Go services + event-driven checkout
products.created fans out to independent consumer groups
Checkout events coordinate reservations and payment outcomes.
talos-proxmox: shared operators + telemetry • this repo: marketplace app roots
Helm: External Secrets, MongoDB, Meilisearch, services, Strimzi Kafka
Apps emit OTLP traces + metrics, JSON logs → node agents.
Dev + prod forward to prod ClickStack; no public dashboard route.
BLUE request PURPLE catalog ORANGE events
One listing write; asynchronous, independent stock and search projections.
Merchant-scoped saga; Checkout coordinates durable commands and results.
initial_qty required (0 valid); listing + outbox commit atomically.
Web returns before stock seed or search projection finishes.
Checkout DB + outbox → Kafka commands; service results → Checkout inbox.
No stock hold or session before correlated commands.
Browse / seller list → Search/Meili (no live stock); PDP → Products + Inventory.
Checkout gets current prices from Products, never Meilisearch.
Search and stock can lag creation; their consumer groups are independent.
Cart snapshots merchant + price; checkout reprices via Products.
Success → commit stock then finalize order; failures → compensate.
Uncertain payment stays under review; stock rejection never opens payment.
